Reproduce

The exact commands and digests that produce this site from the pinned gin commit.

Every artifact on this site is re-creatable from the pinned commit with the commands below. Nothing is hand-transcribed.

0. Toolchain

node --version          # v22.14.0
npm --version           # 10.9.2
go version              # go version go1.26.0 linux/amd64
npx sourcey --version   # sourcey v3.6.12
runx --version          # runx-cli 0.10.2

The go toolchain reports go1.26.0 because gin's go.mod declares go 1.26.0 and the Go toolchain switches automatically to satisfy it (GOTOOLCHAIN=auto).

1. Pin the target

git clone https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin.git gin
cd gin
git checkout 0f09c3a9b4626d9fe9979cf4d0521d6ae32ab646
git rev-parse HEAD
# 0f09c3a9b4626d9fe9979cf4d0521d6ae32ab646

2. Take the godoc snapshot from that source

sourcey godoc -m . -p ./... -o godoc.json

Output (Sourcey v3.6.12):

Sourcey: wrote godoc snapshot for github.com/gin-gonic/gin
  Packages:    7
  Output:      godoc.json

Digest of the committed snapshot:

sha256sum godoc.json
# 91bfb81dff5fafadf8ea973ee99da82eb5bf0c82d0e0e854ea7e0a88bb070e15

The snapshot is a runx/sourcey godoc snapshot, schema_version: 1, with module_path: github.com/gin-gonic/gin and generated_at recorded in the file. It is committed to this repository so the site can be rebuilt on a JS-only host with no Go toolchain, which is the workflow Sourcey documents for godoc tabs.

3. Build the site

sourcey build

sourcey.config.ts in this repository renders two tabs:

  • Guides — the markdown pages in this repository (introduction.md, coverage.md, gaps.md, reproduce.md);
  • Go API — godoc({ module: "./gin-src", packages: ["./..."], mode: "snapshot", snapshot: "./godoc.json", includeTests: true }).

mode: "snapshot" is deliberate: the published build must be byte-stable and rebuildable without a Go toolchain. The live path was verified separately on the build host with mode: "auto", which re-runs go list + go/parser + go/doc against the pinned clone and produces the same 7 packages.

4. Verify the published site

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://asporeteam.github.io/gin-sourcey-docs/
curl -sS https://asporeteam.github.io/gin-sourcey-docs/go/ | grep -c "gin-gonic"

The published site is the dist/ output of step 3, committed to the main branch of ASporeTeam/gin-sourcey-docs and served by GitHub Pages.

5. Re-measure the findings on the gaps page

# the four undocumented exported entries
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d = json.load(open("godoc.json"))
for p in d["packages"]:
    for t in p.get("types", []):
        if not t.get("doc", "").strip():
            pos = t.get("position") or {}
            print("type", t["name"], pos.get("file"), pos.get("line"))
        for m in t.get("methods", []):
            if not m.get("doc", "").strip():
                pos = m.get("position") or {}
                print("method", t["name"] + "." + m["name"], pos.get("file"), pos.get("line"))
    for f in p.get("funcs", []):
        if not f.get("doc", "").strip():
            pos = f.get("position") or {}
            print("func", f["name"], pos.get("file"), pos.get("line"))
PY

# the README never mentions the QUERY method at this commit
grep -ic query README.md   # 0
